description: The Only Cure is More Green Glow Level 30 Travel to Gnomeregan and bring back High Potency Radioactive Fallout. Be warned, the fallout is unstable and will collapse rather quickly. Ozzie will also require your Heavy Leaden Collection Phial when the task is complete. Requirements: - High Potency Radioactive Fallout
name: The Only Cure is More Green Glow
